newsitem.title: USA: EMB says may loan originations up.
newsitem.headline: EMB says may loan originations up.

text.p: EMB Corp said Thursday loan originations in May 1997 increased approximately 32 percent to $31,954,590 from $24,094,005 in April 1997.
Loan fundings increased to $13,935,600 in May, compared with $10,775,090 in April 1997.

As previously reported, the May increase continued a trend that saw the company's second fiscal quarter of 1997, ended March 31, 1997, recording $56,609,743 in loan originations, up 442 percent over the $10,436,740 reported in the second fiscal quarter of 1996, the company said.
